acceptance.given: Package A validation is initiated using the repository-owned terminal pytest selection.

oracle.expected: The pytest terminal selection reports executed coverage for every required Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration case, with independent expected results and explicit case/assertion mappings; no required case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, or reduced to zero executed cases, and an expected rejection of a negative fixture counts as a passing test.
forbidden: A missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error required case is reported as passing.
An expected rejection of a negative fixture is treated as an overall suite failure.
oracle.observable: Pytest terminal output and exit status show execution of the complete registered Package A case selection across all four categories.

acceptance.then: The terminal result shows all required cases from the four Package A categories executed and passed under their independent expected results and case/assertion mappings.
acceptance.when: When Package A validation runs, inspect the terminal pytest invocation and its resulting pytest report and exit status for the repository-owned selection and complete category coverage.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the repository-owned Package A terminal pytest selection and fail the acceptance when any required unit, boundary, negative, or CLI integration case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, not executed, or reported with a harness error; treat an expected negative-fixture rejection as a passing case.

slice_hint.behavior_change: The Package A terminal validation has one repository-owned pytest selection that executes every required unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration case and exposes completeness in its terminal report.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state or schema changes; reverting the terminal-selection implementation restores the prior Package A validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A validation transitions from initiated to a terminal report that demonstrates execution of all required case categories under the repository-owned pytest selection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The repository-owned Package A terminal pytest selection exits successfully and reports executed unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases with no required case missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error.
